message.content: {"reason":"The current trusted accuracy (0.7527) is limited because the GBDT anchor branch in GBDTFeatureEncoder only receives raw ordinal categoricals and binaries, so it cannot cheaply express the coupon×distance×income interactions that dominate acceptance. Historical experiments show that wiring in the GBDT branch and enriching its interaction representation gave reliable lift, while standalone target-encoding-only changes failed to move HistGBM enough. The highest-leverage, lowest-risk refinement is therefore to widen the GBDT input representation with stateless engineered numerics already used by the TabM branch, leaving HGB hyperparameters, folds, seeds, blend search, and persistence unchanged.","module":["data_processing_and_feature_engineering"],"plan":{"data_processing_and_feature_engineering":"WHAT: Extend GBDTFeatureEncoder._cols() and its fit/transform methods so the HistGradientBoosting branch receives the same stateless engineered numeric features currently produced only inside FeatureEngineer._base: age_num, income_num, education_num, time_hour, expiration_hours, is_morning, is_lunch, is_evening, *_ord frequency ordinals, freq_sum, freq_known, freq_missing, distance_est, near_coupon, is_bar, is_coffee, is_restaurant, is_carryout, is_cheap_restaurant, income_x_children, and freq_per_distance, in addition to the existing raw categorical/ordinal and binary/temperature columns. WHY: these row-wise transforms (no labels involved) give the histogram splitter direct access to composite splits such as freq_per_distance <= t and is_cheap_restaurant=1 AND income_num <= t, which previously required many chained splits through ordinal levels and exceeded max_leaf_nodes=31; this addresses the GBDT branch starvation identified as the root cause of the blend being capped near the MLP alone. HOW: add a private static _engineered_numerics(df) helper in GBDTFeatureEncoder that mirrors FeatureEngineer._base exactly for derived columns, call it in both fit(df) and transform(df), append the engineered names to feature_names_, extend medians_ so their fit-time medians are estimated only on the outer-train DataFrame passed to fit (never on validation/test rows), and set cat_mask_ False for all engineered numeric columns while keeping True for NOMINAL_CATS + FREQ_COLS. INTERFACE: preserve GBDTFeatureEncoder.fit(df)->self, transform(df)->np.ndarray, fit_transform(df), feature_names_, cat_mask_, and medians_ exactly as consumed by cmd_train/cmd_predict; do not change HGB_CONFIG, build_hgb(cat_mask, seed), fold splits, seeds, blend-weight search, artifact filenames, or the CLI contract."}}
